Results.ReviewText:
I was gifted this 22in Weber charcoal grill, used. I initially thought I’d use it for grilling burgers and dogs when I threw a large party. When I began to read up on this in different forums, I realized I could do ANYTHING with this grill. ANYTHING. With the right accessories, I can smoke ribs 3-2-1 without having to add to my charcoal. This beast BBQs or Grills anything better than my $1000 Tr Pellet Grill. I’ll keep the pellet grill around, but this is my go to. I have to monitor the temp with my own probe, but I’d still do that even if the lid that a thermometer. Get yourself a Large charcoal basket and you’ll be busting out the best BBQ on the block. 

Sure the more expensive models have nice things to have, but none of them are necessary. You’ll get the exact same outcome on this and the Anniversary model.*** 

I have a family BBQ Comp annually. This grill helped me win this year. 

*** I’m buying a yellow anniversary model. And I might get a kettle grill tattoo.
Results.Title: Workhorse of BBQ

Photos.Caption: Our 24 year old kettle lookin’ good
Our 24 year old, still cookin’ good!

Results.ReviewText:
My family purchased this 22” charcoal Kettle 
24 years ago this month. We have taken care of it, kept it covered, and used it every year since. Replacing only the cooking grill every few years. Growing up our parents had always trusted the Weber brand, so when we moved into our first home we bought this Weber kettle. It has lived up to the quality, workmanship, and product durability that can’t be said about other brands. We’re still cooking with it and hoping to pass it down to our kids for them to enjoy grilling with their families! 
Thanks Weber for making such a good product!
Results.Title: An oldie but still cookin’ and lookin’ hot!
